title: odds-api-io: Official Python SDK for Odds-API.io
description: Official Python SDK for Odds-API.io, a real-time sports betting odds API covering 365+ bookmakers, 34 sports and 12,000+ leagues. The package provides synchronous and asynchronous clients for sports, leagues, events, per-event odds, odds movements, participants, bookmaker selection, value bets and arbitrage bets. Maintained by Outlier AS. Documentation at https://docs.odds-api.io.
